name: Graphene Hall bar · Liqiao Xia structure
description: Liqiao Xia (MIT) structure, as used in the lab's DRC notes: a graphite bottom gate under hBN, the graphene (monolayer here; twisted / helical stacks add pieces) under a top hBN, a metal top gate, and 1D edge contacts. Board etch, Hall-bar (device) etch and contacts are separate EBL steps.

layers.name: Substrate
layers.notes: Choose 285 nm SiO2 on doped Si (usable as a global back gate) or on resistive Si.

layers.name: Graphite bottom gate
layers.notes: 'few-layer graphene strip' in the paper. Lab DRC: sticks out of the bottom BN on one side for its contact.
layers.literature: BG stack (hBN + graphite) by PC, released on 285 nm SiO2/Si, 350 °C 12 h vacuum anneal, AFM contact-mode clean (L.-Q. Xia).

layers.name: Bottom hBN
layers.notes: Lab DRC: larger than the BG in three directions.

layers.name: Graphene
layers.literature: Helical trilayer: one monolayer laser-cut into three, each rotated 1.8° at pick-up (room temperature).

layers.name: Top hBN
layers.notes: Lab DRC: covers the good graphene regions (graphene may tear at the top-BN edge).

layers.name: Metal top gate

thickness_nm.suggested_source: Fab Manual (Sihong), Graphene Devices - New / Nov 2025 (pending)
Fab Manual (Sihong), Graphene Devices - New / Nov 2025 (pending)

layers.notes: Delete this layer for a device without a top gate.
layers.literature: Paper: 25-65 nm Au on a 2-5 nm Cr or Ti adhesion layer (thermal evaporation). Lab default Ti/Au 5/30 nm (Fab Manual, pending).

layers.name: 1D edge contacts

thickness_nm.suggested_source: Fab Manual (Sihong), Graphene Devices - New / Nov 2025 (pending)
Fab Manual (Sihong), Graphene Devices - New / Nov 2025 (pending)

layers.literature: Paper: 63-75 nm Au on 2-5 nm Cr. Lab: Cr/Au 5/~60 nm, thicker than BN/Gr/BN.

references.cite: L.-Q. Xia et al., arXiv:2310.12204 (helical trilayer graphene), Methods A
Fab Manual (Sihong), Graphene Devices - New / Nov 2025

process: Bottom stack: PC picks up an hBN flake and a few-layer graphite strip; release on 285 nm SiO2/Si; 350 °C 12 h vacuum anneal; AFM contact-mode clean.
Top stack: a second PC stamp picks up the top hBN and the graphene piece(s) at room temperature (rotate between pieces for twisted stacks).
Release onto the bottom stack at 150-170 °C; find a bubble-free region by AFM.
Board etch (BN-Test, 5-10 nm more than top + bottom BN), with top-BN-only check windows.   [UStack Stage 2: board etch]
Metal top gate (Ti/Au or Cr/Au).   [UStack Stage 2: gate]
Hall-bar (device) etch: arms ≥ 1.5 µm beyond the BG for 1D contacts.   [UStack Stage 2: Hall-bar etch]
1D contacts: etch top BN, graphene 7-10 s, 5-10 nm of bottom BN; Cr/Au 5/~60 nm.   [UStack Stage 2: contacts]
